turns.user: what should I eat about an hour before the gym today?
turns.reply:
Go for a banana about 30 to 45 minutes before training. 🍌

The simple carbs digest quickly to top up your muscle glycogen so you have immediate energy for your lower body session today, without sitting heavy in your stomach.

A slice of toast with a little jam is another great option if you prefer!
